sequence.text: {shot} shot; the camera makes one slow, gentle, steady {move} that keeps going for the whole clip but covers only a very short distance, about a thirtieth of the frame width in total; the camera stays at the same height with a fixed lens, never moves closer to anything and never zooms in; it never travels down the aisle, path or room, so the last frame shows almost the same view as the first frame, every object still in frame.

The view through the windows stays frozen like a soft, slightly out-of-focus still photograph of {window}, with nothing moving outside; every window pane keeps exactly the same size and shape; no new buildings, lights, people or trees appear in the window view.
The air inside the room is perfectly clean, clear and still: no particles, flakes, dust or sparkles float or fall anywhere inside the room.
Only the flames and the lights inside the room move.
Light snowflakes drift down slowly through the cold air.
Every street, square, path, stall and terrace stays completely empty and deserted for the whole clip: nobody walks in or appears anywhere, not even tiny figures far in the background.

The {lock} keep their exact shape and position; every door stays exactly as open or closed as in the first frame; no new objects, people, hands or text appear; no statues, busts, sculptures or figures of people.
The {light} stays as bright and warm as the first frame throughout, with the same colors.

fields.deep: true khi cảnh sâu (lối đi, hành lang, dãy kệ, lối giữa nhà nguyện) hoặc toàn cảnh ngoài trời rộng: chỉ slide/arc
fields.window: cảnh thấy qua cửa sổ, tiếng Anh, không chữ gốc snow (vd. 'dark pine trees and a lit village at night'); "" nếu không thấy cửa sổ
fields.snowfall: true khi cảnh ngoài trời có tuyết đang rơi trong ảnh
fields.motion: 2–4 câu tiếng Anh, mỗi câu một thứ chuyển động CÓ TRONG ẢNH và ở đâu (lửa, nến, khói cốc, đèn cây, hơi nước, mặt nước, khói ống khói, cực quang, đèn toa…), theo câu mẫu ở blocks.json → video.motion / VIDEO.md
fields.extra: 0–2 câu tùy chọn: chợ/phố đã đóng cửa vắng người, tàu đứng yên trên ray, thú ngoài trời…
fields.lock: danh sách vật chính để khóa, tiếng Anh, số nhiều (vd. 'stone fireplace, Christmas tree, armchair, coffee table and window frames')
fields.light: room | market stall | street | scene … (chủ ngữ câu ánh sáng)
fields.sound: âm thanh hợp cảnh, tiếng Anh (vd. 'a soft crackling fire and a quiet cozy room tone')
